field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Models actually invoked; [] for tasks with no LLM.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Preserve each frozen criterion, actual value and pass/fail independently of task completion.
field_principles.cross_backend_efficacy_claimed: Two clustered sessions cannot establish backend efficacy.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic elapsed work; record phase spans separately.
field_principles.ended_at_utc: Actual terminal construction time in UTC.
field_principles.execution_venue: Top-level orchestration is host; board rows name kv260, gatemate or polarfire.
field_principles.field_principles: Keep ordinary values at top level; put their explanations in this map.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* verdict names check, upstream, artifact_field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:. External absence starts blocked_. Failed acceptance forbids positive.
field_principles.inference_mode: live_gpu only after actual CUDA work.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the operation actually executed.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Actual class determines the duration floor; never pad duration or relabel to pass.
field_principles.local_scored_path_ready_score: Actual dispatch, generated engine and policy consumption, not import or HTTP success.
field_principles.model_invoked: Current task execution only; historical sources and injected fixtures are separate.
field_principles.new_solve_claimed: A solve requires registry precheck and live replay; this dry run defaults false.
field_principles.official_leaderboard_score_reported: Local public-gateway sessions do not expose a hidden competition score.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: True only after action replay through the shipped reproduction gate.
field_principles.per_game_results: Backend, seed, adapter disabled, actions, valid models, progress and cost for each session.
field_principles.phase_spans: Measured model load, generation, scoring and validation times.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Observed paths, resources, model identity and upstream checks before expensive work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze seeds and schedules before observing evaluation labels.
field_principles.raw_request_manifest: Exact model, prompt, parameters and response hashes for every call.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: New reproduced levels only; zero is a legitimate outcome.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash the exact settings, inputs and raw rows supporting the result.
field_principles.rows: Every comparison retains one row per independent unit and arm, with errors and abstentions.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260912; retain actual UTC start and end timestamps.
field_principles.runner_receipt: Task-owned invocation identity and actual transport counts, not copied upstream receipts.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Predeclared independent units, attempted/completed/censored units, and stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact and bind experiment_id and milestone to this task.
field_principles.scored_dryrun_complete_score: Every planned local backend has a complete outcome or an explicit external block.
field_principles.selection_receipt: Freeze the metadata-only game selection and exclusions before model work.
field_principles.solve_provenance: live_agent_self_discovery for any credited solve; development_proxy for any off-path probe.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hash source code, public inputs, private evaluator inputs and raw output files.
field_principles.status: Terminal complete or blocked only; unfinished work uses a separate checkpoint path.
field_principles.submission_configuration_diff: Every difference from the tracked scored kernel, including unavailable NVFP4, Blackwell and gateway.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain exact validation commands and outcomes beside the terminal evidence.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. External incompleteness is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when the verification authority also defines correctness; separate code is insufficient independence.
